headline: Vanguard win at last after four defeats and a draw
dek: Vanguard's win over Cal State East Bay was their first of the season, after a draw and four defeats. It came with the leakiest defence in the conference: fifteen goals conceded against five scored, more than any other programme has let in.
displaced_by: Vanguard's first win; the old dek no longer held once Concordia Irvine matched Hawai'i Hilo's three wins and Hilo lost again

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Concordia Irvine's thirteen goals have come from eleven different scorers, yet they have still conceded ten and lost two of their six matches.

wire.line: Chaminade have lost all five matches they have played; no other programme is still without a point.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Twelve matches dated in August still carry no published result, the earliest of them Vanguard's on the season's first day; the Vanguard matches that do have a score have brought one win, one draw and four defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Chaminade have lost all five of their matches, scoring three and conceding thirteen; the trip to Western Oregon was the fifth defeat.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hawai'i Hilo have lost two matches in a row after opening with three wins, scoring five and conceding four across the five.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Cole Friesen has scored twice for Point Loma from twenty shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Dominican (Calif.) have drawn three of their six matches and won none, scoring eight and conceding twelve.

last_match.line: Vanguard had not won a match before this one; Cal State East Bay had drawn with Dominican (Calif.) and lost at Westmont.

next_match.line: Hawai'i Hilo have yet to draw a match; their last two have both been defeats after an opening run of wins.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
